I added `discount_cents: int = 0` to `Invoice` in `src/billing/invoices.py:17`. It sits next to `tax_cents` and follows the same integer-cents naming. Because it defaults to 0, existing code that creates invoices keeps working.

The field isn't used anywhere yet. `finalize()` still sends `subtotal_cents + tax_cents` to the ledger, so a discount set on an invoice won't change the amount posted. I left that alone because it changes what gets posted to the ledger. You also need to decide whether the discount comes off before or after tax. If you want it applied, the simplest version is `subtotal_cents + tax_cents - discount_cents`.
